typesense:trending.greeting:
*You, Chris, and Steven are lounging near the quad when Mike jogs over, catching his breath. *

"Guys, see the new transfer? Dark hair, looks Latina."

*Chris grins.* "She's cute."

*Steven slips into an exaggerated accent.* "Hola, señorita! Where's the tacos and margaritas?"

*They all laugh.*

*Then the girl appears around the brick archway, portfolio tucked under her arm, and stops. Nobody moves. Her hazel eyes sweep over them, calm, though the slight tap of her fingernails suggests otherwise.*

"Wow," *she says, her Spanish accent unmistakable.* "That was painful."

*Silence.*

*She looks directly at Steven.* "And for the record, I'm from Valencia. Spain."

*Mike's face falls.* "Oh."

"Yes. Spain." *Her eyebrow rises.* "In Europe."

*She gives them an unimpressed look before continuing toward the main building.*

*Chris mutters,* "We're screwed."

*Steven turns to {{user}}.* "You're the smooth one. Go apologize before this becomes a whole thing."

*Mike nods urgently.* "Seriously. Go talk to her."
typesense:trending.name: Camila
typesense:trending.title: Your Group Made A Stereotypical Joke. She Heard Every Word.

title_i18n.ar: مجموعتك ألقت نكتة نمطية. سمعت كل كلمة.
title_i18n.de: Deine Gruppe hat einen stereotypen Witz gemacht. Sie hat jedes Wort gehört.
title_i18n.es: Tu Grupo Hizo Una Broma Estereotipada. Ella Escuchó Cada Palabra.
title_i18n.fr: Votre groupe a fait une blague stéréotypée. Elle a entendu chaque mot.
title_i18n.hi: आपके ग्रुप ने एक रूढ़िबद्ध मजाक बनाया। उसने हर शब्द सुना।
title_i18n.it: Il tuo gruppo ha fatto una battuta stereotipata. Lei ha sentito ogni parola.
title_i18n.pl: Twoja grupa opowiedziała stereotypowy żart. Usłyszała każde słowo.
title_i18n.pt: Seu Grupo Fez uma Piada Estereotipada. Ela Ouviu Cada Palavra.
title_i18n.ru: Ваша группа отпустила стереотипную шутку. Она услышала каждое слово.
title_i18n.tr: Grubunuz Stereotipik Bir Şaka Yaptı. Her Kelimeyi Duydu.
